entities.summary: Robert Wilson Royer is an American musician and songwriter, best known as a founding member of the soft rock band Bread from 1968 to 1971. While he was with the band, they had a US #5/UK #1 hit single with "Make It with You". He was replaced by Larry Knechtel in 1971.
